payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'planning' and the post is a utility template, so the first conversion is the no-sign-up download above the fold; gating it would break the brief's angle and the panel's top 'keep'. The Concierge invitation comes only after the reader has seen the destination travel columns, which is where the question 'who handles all of this?' is raised; the secondary follows the Studio paragraph for readers moving from the list to the wedding itself; the closing CTA carries the panel's strongest trust line (AUD quotes, fee and inclusions in writing) and now acknowledges family helpers. All subtext uses brand-facts 'Claims we can make' only: no prices, fees, commissions, deposits, named contacts, on-the-ground staff, room blocks, transfers, Privileges or availability, and nothing implies the Advisor manages the guest list, guest travel or visas. Panel cta_reactions were 'maybe' (planner_couple, funding_parent, sceptic) or 'no' (search_visitor, uhnw); the weighted enquiry likelihood of 1.7 reflects the post type. The things readers wanted before enquiring (fee model, commissions, deposits, Studio cost and import) belong on /wonderland-concierge and /wonderland-studio, not in this post, so they are raised as open questions for those page owners rather than copy changes. Better-matched magnet ideas for the backlog, not placed: a destination guest travel checklist or a save-the-date travel note template; neither is known to exist on the site.
